locations.note: Aveline's adventures take place in colonial New Orleans and its bayous.
Aveline meets Madeleine at the cathedral to be initiated into the Templar Order.
Aveline follows the slaves sent out of New Orleans to a Templar dig at Chichén Itzá, and finds her mother Jeanne there.
In 1777, with Connor's help, Aveline hunts a Loyalist officer in New York who knows the Company Man's identity.

routes.name: Aveline
routes.note: 1765 to 1777: New Orleans and the bayou, the Yucatán, and New York.
